decisions.reason: Turnaround management software sits close to the firm's docking and gate expertise, has kept a dedicated page in both years, and the firm's own R&D lets it learn from early results and refine the product.

The apron connectivity module builds on the firm's installed apron equipment base, and its move from a mention to a dedicated page signals growing commitment that the firm's related knowledge and R&D can support.
Revenue and billing software is somewhat further from the firm's core operational know-how, but its upgrade to a dedicated page and the firm's R&D capacity favour keeping and improving it.

Equipment monitoring software applies directly to the firm's installed hardware and maintenance expertise, which lets it interpret usage data and improve the product, and it was elevated to a dedicated page in 2024.
